placeOfSupply.art18_2a: Article 18(2)(a) of the Greek VAT Code (Law 5144/2024): services to a taxable person are taxed where the customer is established. A legal person with a VAT number counts as a taxable person (para. 1(b)).
placeOfSupply.art18_15: Article 18(15) of the Greek VAT Code (Law 5144/2024): certain services to a private individual established outside the EU are taxed outside Greece — consultants, engineers, design offices, lawyers, accountants, advertising, licensing of rights, supply of staff, etc.

caveats.immovableProperty: If the service relates to immovable property in Greece (e.g. design, supervision or construction works), Greek VAT applies (Article 18(4)).
caveats.listedServicesOnly: Applies only to the services listed in para. 15; for any other service to a private individual Greek VAT applies (para. 2(b)).
caveats.vatNumberNotVerified: The customer's VAT number is declared, not verified (VIES or the national register).
